name: player receiving yards rate per player target
description: The rate aggregator on a player-denominated period, which routes through a per-player denominator CTE rather than the team-play or game families.
expected_query: with "t435ac8226eb11949833f1dfbc5c6e0ea" as materialized (select "nfl_plays"."target_pid" as "pid", SUM(CASE WHEN target_pid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as rate_type_total_count from "nfl_plays" where "play_type" in ('PASS', 'RUSH', 'CONV', 'KOFF', 'PUNT', 'FGXP', 'FREE') and "nfl_plays"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_plays"."season_year" in (2023) group by "nfl_plays"."target_pid"), "rate_aggregate_8ff5087ccc8e" as materialized (select nfl_plays.target_pid AS pid, SUM(CASE WHEN nfl_plays.is_completion = true THEN nfl_plays.receiving_yards ELSE 0 END) AS m_2205f2f1663c from "nfl_plays" inner join "nfl_games" on "nfl_games"."esbid" = "nfl_plays"."esbid" where "nfl_plays"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_plays"."season_year" in (2023) and "nfl_plays"."play_type" in ('PASS', 'RUSH', 'KOFF', 'PUNT', 'FGXP', 'FREE') and "nfl_plays"."season_type" in ('REG') group by nfl_plays.target_pid) select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, CAST(MAX(rate_aggregate_8ff5087ccc8e.m_2205f2f1663c) AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(CAST(MAX(t435ac8226eb11949833f1dfbc5c6e0ea.rate_type_total_count) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS rec_yds_from_plays_0, "player"."primary_position" from "player" left join "t435ac8226eb11949833f1dfbc5c6e0ea" on "t435ac8226eb11949833f1dfbc5c6e0ea"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "rate_aggregate_8ff5087ccc8e" on "rate_aggregate_8ff5087ccc8e"."pid" = "player"."pid" group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by 4 DESC NULLS LAST, "player"."pid" asc limit 500
